item.goetyarcana.soul_burst_focus.info: Hurls a shard of condensed void: 6 flat damage plus 7.5% of the target's max health, and not even a boss's damage cap can blunt it. Cast with a Void Staff to inflict Void Touched and steal the target's boons.
item.goetyarcana.void_scythe.charge: Hold right-click to charge with both hands; release a piercing scythe wave (5s, passes through walls)
item.goetyarcana.void_scythe.effects: On hit: 70% Void Touched I / 30% Void Touched II; 5% Execution
item.goetyarcana.void_scythe.creative_on: Crafted by the End Ritual · requires a Dark Metal Scythe
effect.goetyarcana.execution.description: After 5 seconds: normal enemies die instantly, elites lose 10% max health, bosses lose 20% max health (ignores boss damage caps).
death.attack.voidWave: %1$s was torn apart by a void scythe wave
death.attack.voidWave.player: %1$s was torn apart by %2$s's void scythe wave
effect.goetyarcana.void_eye.description: +20% reload speed and arrow velocity per stack, up to 3 stacks. Removed when switching weapons.
effect.goetyarcana.bleed.description: Lose 2 HP per second for 6 seconds.
item.goetyarcana.void_crossbow.info: Hits grant Void Eye: +20% reload speed and arrow velocity per stack, up to 3. At 3 stacks arrows apply Bleed. Prefers Void Bolts; plain arrows work as a fallback.
item.goetyarcana.void_crossbow.robe: With a Void Robe: bolts home in on enemies, pierce up to 6 targets, then detonate at the cap.
item.goetyarcana.void_crossbow.recipe: End Ritual: vanilla crossbow + 2 Void Eyes + 2 Void Blocks
item.goetyarcana.void_crossbow_bolt.info: Void Crossbow ammunition; explodes after 4 seconds whether it hits or not.
item.goetyarcana.void_scythe.wip: The model is currently WIP and may be revised later.
effect.goetyarcana.void_explosion.descri: Explodes around the carrier after 4 seconds.
